description: The same command with back-EMF-timed commutation. The forced ramp climbs normally, then the drive loses the rotor the moment it hands off to the zero-cross detector.
notes: Climbs to 646 rad/s on the ramp, drops to 470, then collapses to ~40 rad/s within half a second and free-runs there on the timeout fallback.
States go ST_SL_RAMP (6) -> ST_SS_UNLOCKED (9); it never reports lock.
Collapses to the same ~40 rad/s for every commanded handoff from 31 to 898 rad/s, so the result is independent of the command — the detector is not tracking at all.
Not a back-EMF magnitude problem: at 646 rad/s el this motor's back-EMF is ~0.6 V.
title: Closed-loop six-step collapses at handoff
